messages:
alex: Heads-up — kicking off prod deploy v2.11.0 in ~5m. Primary objective: route traffic to new LLM routing (routing/llm-v2) with a dripflow ramp. Plan: set flag to 10% (global) excluding eu-west, then 50% after 30m if signals look good. Pin model to gpt-opus-3@2026-03-15 for the new route. Rollback criteria: 5xx > 0.5% or p95 latency +30% over baseline. cc @sre-oncall @maria :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: v2.11.0 rollout triggered by alex at 1768809991. Canary cluster up (3 pods). Initial actions queued:
```
/ff set routing/llm-v2 10% --exclude-region eu-west
/model pin router gpt-opus-3@2026-03-15
/monitor query router p95,error_rate
```
I will post status updates every 5m.

jamie: Quick ask — can we make the 10% cohort only mobile clients and api-key tier=free? last EU spike was mobile-heavy.

alex: Good call. Updating cohort: mobile + free-tier only for initial 10%. EU excluded entirely. Thanks.

maria: +1. Also please add a short timeout bump on the router for the new model path (200ms -> 350ms) while we assess. That prevented a flurry last time.

alex: Done — temporary timeout applied to routing path. Logging change: `router.timeout.ms=350`.

deploy-bot: status @ 1768811000 — routing/llm-v2 at 10% (mobile/free-tier) excluding eu-west. Canaries healthy (2/3 ready). Telemetry pipeline connected.

chris: Seeing early noise from canary-2: 5xx ~1.2% over last 3m, p95 +42% vs baseline, CPU on canary-2 at 83%. Stack excerpt below:
```
[router-2] 2026-03-15T12:03:22Z ERROR upstream request failed: context deadline exceeded
[router-2] 2026-03-15T12:03:23Z 502 from llm-backend gpt-opus-3
```
Not great.

sre-oncall: Those exceed the rollback threshold (errors >0.5% and p95 +30%). Recommend immediate rollback of the feature flag. If we want to iterate we can pin fallback model instead, but safety first.

alex: Agreed — initiating rollback of routing/llm-v2 to 0% across prod now. Pinning fallback model gpt-opus-2@2026-02-28 for router path. Opening an incident and capturing traces. Executing commands:
```
/ff set routing/llm-v2 0% --all-regions
/model pin router gpt-opus-2@2026-02-28
/incident create "v2.11.0 canary llm regression"
```
Will post when complete.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: action complete at 1768811540 — routing/llm-v2 set to 0% across all regions. Model pin updated to gpt-opus-2@2026-02-28. Canary traffic drained. Notifying release channel.

jamie: Thanks — capture KV cache hit-rates and batch-size histograms for the canary window. We need to know if the regression is model-related or traffic-shaped.

maria: Filing follow-up: add a dev build with higher concurrency limits and smaller batch sizes for local repro, and schedule a short postmortem in runbook. :thumbsup:

alex: Copy — pulling traces into the incident ticket and scheduling a short sync 30m from now. Rolling back release notes to drafted state.
